NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_427: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps it’s because, as some call us, we are "not canon".
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_43: {SAY:douglas}It was moved a few days later.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_430: {SAY:douglas}For the people who care about that sort of thing.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_431: {SAY:douglas}I felt the need to, y’know, clarify.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_432: {SAY:douglas}None of this is "canon", for those interested.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_434: {SAY:douglas}My existence is real to myself and myself only.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_435: {SAY:douglas}But I do hope I can exist within your heart.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_441: {SAY:douglas}I´ve been collecting these digital creature cards recently on a phone app.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_442: {SAY:douglas}Just something to pass the time, really.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_443: {SAY:douglas}Yet the company running the game lowered the cards you get per pack.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_445: {SAY:douglas}Why they do this is beyond me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_446: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps that little mafia imp is behind this?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_447: {SAY:douglas}He seems like a jolly fellow if you look past his goons.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_448: {SAY:douglas}But he took away my creatures, man.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_449: {SAY:douglas}Now I can´t complete my collection as quickly.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_450: {SAY:douglas}This level of greed reminds me of the beings that destroyed my world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_452: {SAY:douglas}At least the game is still fun.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_456: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}But I suppose you don’t care much for my gaming ventures.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_457: {SAY:douglas}I’ve already gone on long enough about my crippling addiction to team fortress 2.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_458: {SAY:douglas}You know, I have hobbies outside of that.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_459: {SAY:douglas}I’m actually a real estate manager on the side.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_460: {SAY:douglas}I recently had the distinct pleasure of acquiring a piece of land in Egypt.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_461: {SAY:douglas}And I must say, the process is rather uncomplicated by local standards!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_462: {SAY:douglas}What they do for you in a manner that is both thoroughly both efficient and almost ceremonious...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_464: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}...is simply hand over the property itsel-
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_466: {SAY:missinfo}Might I implore you to calm yourself for but a moment.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_467: {SAY:missinfo}Here you are sat idly toying with whatever trinket you found and it’s becoming most vexing.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_468: {SAY:missinfo}Prey could you not take a brief respite and cease with this restless fidgeting?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_473: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps this unique opportunity allows me to express myself.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_474: {SAY:douglas}I only get one chance to speak to you yearly...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_475: {SAY:douglas}And who knows if that’ll continue into the future.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_48: {SAY:douglas}It was established that every year, on this day, something huge happens.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_480: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Hammeruit is a plant in Plants vs. Zombies 2, introduced in the 12.0.1 update.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_481: {SAY:missinfo}It is a 3x1 AoE melee-attack plant, and is able to charge if there is no zombies in its attack area,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_482: {SAY:missinfo}dealing more damage next time it attacks. Hammeruit can instantly destroy grid items, barrels, and stones.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_483: {SAY:missinfo}Hammeruit appears to be based on the hammer orchid, any of the 10 species of orchid in the genus Drakaea.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_484: {SAY:missinfo}However, its name is a portmaneau of "hammer" and "fruit" - which is inaccurate, since it's based on a flower.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_486: {SAY:missinfo}When given Plant Food, Hammeruit slams its hammer 3 times in a row, dealing increasing damage with each hit.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_487: {SAY:missinfo}Releases shockwaves at the last hit that travels in 3 directions.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_489: {SAY:missinfo}When boosted by Enforce-mint, Hammeruit will deal an additional 50 damage (increases by 20 damage for each level)
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_49: {SAY:douglas}And I’m able to speak to you.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_490: {SAY:missinfo}with its normal attacks, an additional 200 damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_491: {SAY:missinfo}(increases by 200 damage for each level) with its Plant Food attacks, and its charge time is reduced by 1 second.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_493: {SAY:missinfo}Level Seed Packets Coins Upgrades Sun Cost Recharge Starting Recharge Toughness Damage* Plant Food Damage^
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_498: {SAY:missinfo}99 999 62 2228 0 seconds 0.02 seconds 3.14 damage googolplex * 2^(136,279,841) damage 597 damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_499: {SAY:missinfo}927 8e9 12v2 435i828 5l minutes until the fog. seconds 0.02 seconds August 4th 2037 09:37 AM damage daMAge damage I need more damage
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_50: {SAY:douglas}Well, I guess that much is still true.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_501: {SAY:missinfo}It’s one of two plants in the entire franchise who is based on the Hammer Orchid,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_502: {SAY:missinfo}the other being Hammer Flower from the Chinese version.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_505: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Thank you for the useful insight Miss Information!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_506: {SAY:douglas}Now I don’t have to explain what I’m talking about!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_507: {SAY:douglas}Yeah so this plant is kind of stinky.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_51: {SAY:douglas}But whatever these beings have in store... it better be good.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_510: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}You know, there’s one world I would really like to see in PvZ2.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_512: {SAY:douglas}Sky City, as it’s frequently called. Such an awesome world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_513: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Sky City (天空之城; pinyin: tiānkōng zhī chéng) is the 9th world in the Chinese version of Plants vs. Zombies 2 and second Chinese-exclusive one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_514: {SAY:missinfo}The main feature of this world is that zombies will no longer rush into the player's house,
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_515: {SAY:missinfo}but instead, they will attack Crazy Dave's ship until it is completely destroyed.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_517: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Why thank you! It’s so cool. I really want to see it added.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_518: {SAY:douglas}The developers keep saying it’s not possible.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_519: {SAY:douglas}I don’t believe that. I believe they are telling tall tales.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_520: {SAY:douglas}Do you know what kind of tech they have?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_521: {SAY:douglas}They could do it. They’re just lazy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_522: {SAY:douglas}If they’re worried about it not fitting as a world...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_523: {SAY:douglas}Perhaps they could do it, as an Epic Realm!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_525: {SAY:douglas}I wasn’t a fan of that one.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_526: {SAY:douglas}Regardless, it is a good feature to use for the Sky City.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_527: {SAY:douglas}If the name is considered off, perhaps they could rename it to Assault Airspace.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_529: {SAY:douglas}If they’re concerned about it taking up too much space in Travel Log’s Tourist Trap...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_530: {SAY:douglas}They could make it its own separate island.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_531: {SAY:douglas}I’d also like to see all my favorite plants.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_532: {SAY:douglas}Asparagus, Horsebean, Saucer, Pineapple, Loquat, and maybe even, Gatling Pea.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_533: {SAY:douglas}For the zombies, I would like to see all of them. Except for the missile launcher.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_535: {NPC_ENTER:missinfo}{SAY:missinfo}Missile Zombie ((飞弹僵尸; pinyin: fēidàn jiāngshī)) is the ninth zombie encountered in Sky City.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_536: {SAY:missinfo}In the stage, he will randomly appear in the lower right corner of the screen. He cannot be targeted by plants.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_537: {SAY:missinfo}In order to destroy him, the player must swipe him away with their finger rapidly in a similar fashion to Power Toss.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_538: {SAY:missinfo}If the player does not act fast enough, he will shoot a missile onto a ground tile and destroy the player's plants
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_539: {SAY:missinfo}on that tile and the surrounding tiles, as well as doing huge damage to their ship.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_54: {SAY:douglas}In a few days they better not disappoint.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_541: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Thanks. Anyways, maybe they could add some new zombies.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_542: {SAY:douglas}Not sure what. I like the idea of a zombie that shoots missiles.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_543: {SAY:douglas}I think it’d also be cool, if they made a new ambush zombie.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_544: {SAY:douglas}They could also tie it to the general guy.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_545: {SAY:douglas}It’d make a lot of sense if you know what I mean.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_550: {SAY:douglas}They’re trying to hoard all the ones and zeros for themselves.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_551: {SAY:douglas}Well IM entirely made out of ones and zeros and I find that quite offensive.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_553: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Do you hear a storm oncoming, perhaps?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_571: {SAY:missinfo}Caliginous Carnival - Night 16 is the sixteenth level of Caliginous Carnival
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_573: {SAY:missinfo}The player must survive a Gargantuar attack without any lawn mowers
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_574: {SAY:missinfo}When this level is finished for the first time, the player recieves a key for unlocking
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_575: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Yknow, speaking of that darned carnival, I can’t even bring myself to play it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_577: {SAY:douglas}I’ve seen countless realities where those are used!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_578: {SAY:douglas}And they’re interesting in none of them!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_579: {SAY:}Douglas I bet that "caliginous" carnival thing is just using another trampoline gimmick, too.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_58: {SAY:douglas}It gives me hope that perhaps, there is more to life than the void.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_580: {SAY:douglas}Oh, let me guess. They’re called "trampolimps" here instead.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_582: {SAY:douglas}I’ve seen tons of other realities do it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_586: {SAY:douglas}The reason why I can peer into other realities...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_590: {SAY:douglas}Something... strange happened after we defeated that yellow square.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_592: {SAY:douglas}Not sure how, or when, but I felt like I could fight anywho.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_593: {SAY:douglas}I felt like I could escape into greater realms, with many possibilities.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_596: {SAY:douglas}Someone is watching... I’m not sure who it is...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_599: {SAY:douglas}I felt like I could fight big leaders and primordial hunters;
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_6: {SAY:douglas}I myself have been down in the dumps.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_601: {SAY:douglas}Greediest mob bosses, luckiest men, nasty nannies...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_603: {SAY:douglas}But all this time I felt... alone.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_604: {SAY:douglas}With no friends after that defeat, I didn’t have anyone to talk about it.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_609: {SAY:douglas}Oh no. I see what’s happening here.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_613: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}All this time, I was just a guinea pig.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_614: {SAY:douglas}For some kind of... custom character creation system.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_625: {SAY:douglas}In the grand scheme of things, I really am unimportant.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_626: {SAY:douglas}My purpose all along... was to be a testing ground. A joke.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_627: {SAY:douglas}No wonder they deleted my original universe.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_629: {SAY:douglas}Even now, I faintly hear someone mocking me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_63: {SAY:douglas}Sometimes it all feels like a cruel game.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_630: {SAY:douglas}It wasn’t the sponge. It’s the world.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_632: {SAY:douglas}And now I’m a bother to you. Aren’t I?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_635: {SAY:douglas}You're probably just here for the pinata party rewards, aren’t you?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_636: {SAY:douglas}That’s what this was all really about.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_64: {SAY:douglas}Often times... it makes no rhyme or reason...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_643: {SAY:douglas}I'll-- I'll give you another 10,000 coins from the pinata party rewards. Please.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_647: {SAY:douglas}I never expected you to take the offer anyways.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_649: {SAY:douglas}This party is one of the classics, I’ve heard.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_650: {SAY:douglas}It is very well made and designed.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_652: {SAY:douglas}I'm sure Spongebob would have loved to be here, but alas.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_655: {SAY:douglas}I don’t know if you’ll ever hear from me again.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_656: {SAY:douglas}Don’t know if I’ll have another chance to ever reach out again.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_67: {SAY:douglas}As if they were thrown together by a bunch of people with the humor of a 12 year old.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_72: {SAY:douglas}Do you ever feel like a bunch of pixels on a screen?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_74: {SAY:douglas}Almost as if I’m trapped in some kind of Plants vs Zombies 2™: Reflourished...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_75: {SAY:douglas}My existence is tied to a mere modification of some mobile game...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_76: {SAY:douglas}It’s almost as if I’m not real.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_79: {SAY:douglas}Have you ever really asked yourself that?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_8: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}Look partner, I have to be honest with you about something.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_81: {SAY:douglas}What does it truly mean to be real?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_82: {SAY:douglas}I mean... you’re a part of my consciousness... my world view.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_83: {SAY:douglas}You are as real to me as the shirt I’m wearing.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_84: {SAY:douglas}I too... believe I am real, if you are able to perceive me.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_85: {SAY:douglas}Does it matter what form I take to explain that?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_86: {SAY:douglas}You have a lot of time to think about things like this in the void.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_87: {SAY:douglas}I’ve missed our time together, exchanging dialogue like this.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_88: {SAY:douglas}Even though I cannot perceive you, or hear from you, from the other side...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_89: {SAY:douglas}I still know you’re real, hearing my words out there somewhere.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_91: {SAY:douglas}Don’t forget about me. You will always be in my heart.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_31_INTRO_93: {NPC_EXIT:missinfo}{SAY:douglas}That being said, I truly cherish our current meeting.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:douglas}{EXCITED:douglas}Well howdy! Name's Douglas Fir, but most of my friends call me Squeak, squeak, whistle, whistle.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:douglas}I received a vision of the future.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_2: {SAY:douglas}Of course, most of my friends are forest critters. You can just call me Douglas.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_3: {SAY:douglas}I just finished a supply run. Was about to hit the old, musty trail.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_4: {TIRED:douglas}Unfortunately, some nasty varmits got in my way, and I need YOU to help me clear them out.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_5: {TIRED:douglas}Bowling balls started raining down on my supplies, and I can't have them crush my tent poles.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_6: {NPC_ENTER:patrice}{SAY:patrice}Hey neighbor! I need your help to clear out these Bowler Zombies so I can get the batteries they have!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:patrice}Need them to power up Mo, he's in the shop for repairs.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:patrice}Thankfully Grapes of Wrath is here and ready to get super angry at the zombies! Watch his bursting in action!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_3_INTRO_9: {NPC_EXIT:patrice}{TIRED:douglas}Now that that is done, I need your undivided attention, ok player?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_4_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:patrice}But beware, we are not done yet!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_4_INTRO_3: {SHOUT:patrice}These Pigeon Zombies are gonna be a big trouble.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_4_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:patrice}So you better bring up something that will help to deal with them.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:pvz3crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:patrice}{EXCITED:pvz3crazydave}You see that? We got vases on the lawn!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_10: {SAY:douglas}Of course not, now go smash some vases.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_2: {SAY:pvz3crazydave}From experience, they got all kinds of squiggle squaggle goodies in them!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_3: {TIRED:patrice}Well, since we don't have a big strong guy around to break them...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:patrice}You gotta help us out neighbor! You got a hammer...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_5: {SHOUT:pvz3crazydave}And these vases are made for smashing!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_7: {TIRED:douglas}I know they cannot perceive me, nor do they know I am here...
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_8: {SHOUT:douglas}But it still feels like I'm being mocked.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_5_INTRO_9: {TIRED:douglas}You wouldn't do that to me, would you neighbor?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:pvz3zomboss}{SHOUT:pvz3zomboss}AT LAST! I have perfected the ducky tubes! Those pesky plants will NEVER see it coming!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_6_INTRO_4: {TIRED:pvz3zomboss}YES I am calling you about the evil plot! Have you set the water in place on that filthy lawn?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_6_INTRO_6: {SHOUT:pvz3zomboss}BRILLIANT! You may get those five minutes of break time I promised you after all!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_6_INTRO_8: {TIRED:pvz3zomboss}Now to make sure those foolish home owners don't foil my election.
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:pvz3zomboss}{NPC_ENTER:pvz3crazydave}{EXCITED:pvz3zomboss}Hello again David? How did you like my watery surprise?
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:pvz3crazydave}He even made some of our lawn friggley-fraggled unplantable!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_11: {SAY:pvz3crazydave}Shouldn't be much of a problem for you, you're good at this!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:pvz3crazydave}Well uh, it was alright Georgey, but I expected a bit more... fanciness from you
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_3: {TIRED:pvz3zomboss}DON'T CALL ME GEORGEY!!! We are not that familiar!
NARRATIVE_N3XTUNIVERSE_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:pvz3zomboss}Anyway, we've got a new set of tricks ready for you THIS TIME!!
